summary: All rounding moved into meterbill/money.py (exact arithmetic, no decimal context); the context line was removed, and the half-even rounding that batch worker threads got from the default context (band charges, effective price) is now passed explicitly. Differential fuzzing against the original showed identical CLI output; inconsistencies kept as-is: batch rounds band charges/effective price half-even vs half-up elsewhere, and 'whole' cash never yields -0.
